build_system: Rojo for syncing to Roblox Studio + python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py to regenerate the .rbxlx file
test_framework: No automated test framework - Roblox Studio is the test environment
test_command: python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py (validates the Lua files parse into the rbxlx format)
verification_instructions: Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py from project root - it should complete without errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is generated by tools/generate_rbxlx.py from the src/ directory
setup_instructions: python3 is pre-installed, no other deps needed
environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio available. Validate by running generate_rbxlx.py which parses all Lua source files.
contribution_requirements: All code changes in src/. Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py after changes to regenerate the .rbxlx file.
key_patterns: Server-authoritative architecture. Services in src/ServerScriptService/Services/. Client controllers in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/. Shared data modules in src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/. RemoteEvents/RemoteFunctions created in Main.server.lua. DataService uses getPlayerData() for server cache and getClientData() for client-safe copy. UI is entirely procedural (no external assets). Golden pets have 'golden = true' field. PetData.Pets defines base pets. PetData.Eggs defines egg pools.
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/ - server-side code. src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ - client-side code. src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared data modules. tools/ - build scripts.
